answer: Reputation-Weighted Jetty Escrow: new identities start at a reputation nadir, so their escrow multiplier is high and every action posts collateral scaled by inverse reputation. Cloning yields fresh low-rep identities paying maximum collateral per transaction, while genuine agents accrue history and shed cost. An echo check cross-references behavioral fingerprints across accounts, flagging correlated clones and holding their escrow longer. Each clone thus pays repeated premium collateral plus delayed settlement, making the marginal duplicate strictly negative-EV.
